description: Agent Governance: submit an exposure or spend cap design: each cap with its amount, what it aggregates over (one order, one agent, one counterparty or the portfolio), its window, what happens to a request above it (reject, downsize, split, queue or allow), the written rule for a changed request and whether the change is recorded, plus any recorded requests that met a cap. The signed report names every cap with no stated scope or window, every breach left undefined or allowed, every downsizing, split or queue with no written rule or no record of the change, and every recorded request that did not follow its cap. Check order inside one payment flow is wever_firewall-order-check and an approval against a standing limit is wever_approval-policy-check. Verdict cap_undefined, breach_unruled, caps_unverified or caps_defined. POST /api/exposure-cap-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-governance-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-governance/.

on_breach.description: What happens to a request above the cap.

records_change.description: A changed request is recorded with its original size and the reason.

rule.description: The written rule for a downsized, split or queued request.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.
